_help: Copy to rubric_<role_id>.json in your hiring folder and fill in with the hiring team BEFORE any interview is scored. 3-10 competencies. Every competency needs a definition and an observable, job-related anchor for each score 1-4. No protected characteristics or proxies (age, background, accent, appearance, school prestige, 'culture fit'): the script rejects them. Keep status 'draft' until the hiring manager approves; then set status 'approved' and approved_by. See rubric-guide.md.

competencies.name: Competency one
competencies.definition: One sentence: what good looks like in this role, as observable behaviour.

anchors.1: What a 1 sounds like: no relevant example, or the example shows the opposite behaviour.
anchors.2: What a 2 sounds like: a relevant example, but with a named gap.
anchors.3: What a 3 sounds like: a specific example that shows the behaviour at the level the role needs.
anchors.4: What a 4 sounds like: as 3, plus a stated, observable step beyond it.
